## Kyrie - PDF Generation & Send  (v4: smart scripts + Client linking)

Webhook -> Prep Payload (1,478 static keymaps + 18 SMARTER Question Scripts that bundle related fields into single asks, avg 13 qs/form vs 22) -> GPT Translator (gpt-4o-mini, JSON mode, explicit derivation rules) -> Fill PDF (https://codeeee.onrender.com) -> Email + Update Call Log + **Append PDF to Client**.

**New in v4 - auto-link to Clients table:**
- After Update Call Log, two new nodes use the response's Client field (the existing Call Log -> Clients link) to GET the matched Client row and PATCH the PDF into its Attachments field, preserving any existing attachments.
- No new schema needed. Works because Call Log already has Client as multipleRecordLinks.

**Plug in:**
- GPT Translator: OpenAI credential (already set on this instance).
- Update Call Log + Get Client Attachments + Append PDF to Client: all use the same Airtable PAT. Replace `Bearer YOUR_AIRTABLE_PAT` on all three.
- Email PDF to Staff: Gmail credential already wired.

const slug = (s) => String(s).toLowerCase().replace(/[^a-z0-9]+/g, "_").replace(/^_|_$/g, "");

const b = $input.first().json.body || $input.first().json;
const rawFormName = b.formName || "";
const formName = FORM_ALIASES[rawFormName] || rawFormName;
const map = KEY_MAPS[formName] || {};
const questionScript = QUESTION_SCRIPTS[formName] || "";

let raw = {};
try { raw = typeof b.answersJson === "string" ? JSON.parse(b.answersJson) : (b.answersJson || {}); } catch (e) { raw = {}; }

// Apply static map: Kyrie key -> PDF field name. Try as-is, then snake_case.
const mapped = {};
const unmapped = {};
for (const [k, v] of Object.entries(raw)) {
  const direct = map[k] || map[slug(k)];
  if (direct) mapped[direct] = v;
  else unmapped[k] = v;
}

// Full list of valid PDF field names (deduped, sorted for stable prompts)
const validFields = [...new Set(Object.values(map))].sort();

return [{ json: {
  recordId:    b.recordId || "",
  formName,
  rawFormName,
  clientName:  b.clientName || "",
  clientPhone: b.clientPhone || "",
  mappedFields: mapped,
  unmappedFields: unmapped,
  validFields,
  questionScript,
  rawAnswers: raw,
  today: new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10)
}}];
